metadata.title: Impressionist Social Scene Album Cover
useCases: Event posters with a vintage social atmosphere

retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for layouts that integrate high-contrast, classic serif typography over a dense, painterly impressionist scene of social gathering.
excludeWhen: the subject is a single isolated person

recipe.visualDefinition: A bustling outdoor social scene rendered in a late 19th-century impressionist style, featuring figures in period attire under dappled sunlight, framed by bold, high-contrast serif typography at the top and bottom edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography acts as a structural frame for the chaotic painterly background
Dappled light spots on clothing mirror the texture of the brushwork
High-contrast white text provides legibility against the dark, saturated oil tones
The dense crowd creates a sense of depth and movement behind the static text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central group of figures in the mid-ground serves as the focal point, surrounded by a dense, receding crowd.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white serif title text at the bottom and the artist name at the top anchor the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top text, down through the central smiling figures, to the bottom title, following the vertical axis of the crowd.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with figures and foliage, using only the text areas for visual relief.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep greens, browns, and blacks in the shadows and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the typography and highlights on clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellows and golds in the straw hats and dappled light spots.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text and the dark, saturated oil painting background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a graceful, curving leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold display serif for titles paired with a smaller, lighter version of the same serif for secondary metadata.
graphicDevices: Text tracking used to span the full width of the canvas
Dappled light texture overlaying parts of the image

candidateDirections.reason: Classic structure with sharp serifs and high contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an impressionist oil painting of a crowded 19th-century outdoor cafe at night with dappled light filtering through trees, featuring people in straw hats and formal attire.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay bold, all-caps white serif text at the top and bottom edges with wide tracking and a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the painting style visibly impressionist with thick brushstrokes?
Is the text high-contrast white and perfectly legible?
Are the figures wearing period-appropriate clothing?
Is the typography centered and balanced at the edges?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the dappled light effect
Saturation of the oil paint colors
mustRedesign: Do not replicate existing brand logos
Ensure the text content is original
postGenerationChecks: Check for visible brushstroke texture in the background
Verify that text does not obscure primary faces
Ensure the lighting feels consistent across the scene
Confirm the serif font has sharp, distinct terminals
